documentedBreaches.title: Bind the opened bundle root to its pre-open identity
documentedBreaches.standard: AGENTS.md engineering principles4/5; preregistered rooted replacement boundary.
documentedBreaches.reason: The two Lstat results are compared with each other but not with the opened os.Root inode. An ABA path substitution can select a replacement/outside root while restoring the original path before the second check.
documentedBreaches.requestedChange: Require the initial selected root to be a non-symlink directory and compare its identity with opened root info and final Lstat; if initial symlinks are explicitly supported, pin/compare the resolved target before opening.
